reviews.title: Comfy and convenient but audio quality is questionable
reviews.comment: It’s a great headset and it’s nice finally escaping wires… But if you’re an audiophile or will listen to music more than gaming I would not recommend these. I can’t tweak the eq settings good enough to keep me satisfied but that can just be a skill issue ofc so take that with a grain of salt
reviews.author: T

reviews.title: Sound quality
reviews.comment: It jumps between your Bluetooth settings, to your phone. Sound quality is minimum at best. My $40 headset was better
